facts.value: Our story started in 1967 with a pioneering spirit to break new ground. From our headquarters in Norway, KSAT has grown into a world-leading global space company - built to deliver secure, resilient, always-on services. For decades, we have helped shape the ground segment industry, setting the standard through innovation and operational excellence. KSAT was among the first to introduce near real-time operational monitoring services in the 1990s, and we helped define the industry benchmark by pioneering near real-time maritime situational awareness and operational oil spill detection. Today, we continue to unlock the full potential of our partners’ missions through a global network of sveral hundred antennas across 40+ ground station locations, optimized for polar, inclined and equatorial orbits. In addition, we provide Earth Observation services with some of the fastest delivery times available - supporting time-sensitive, operational decision-making when every minute counts. Our customers include public and commercial users with urgent operational requirements, as well as satellite owners and operators who depend on high-performance ground services. With 24/7/365 operations, KSAT

[website] Wikipedia: "Kongsberg Satellite Services AS (KSAT) is a Norwegian-based company. KSAT has the most extensive ground station network globally, and the world's largest ground station for support of polar orbiting satellites located at 78° North - Svalbard, Norway. They are a provider of ground network services an" [wikipedia] Business address: Prestvannvegen 38, 9011 TROMSØ. [brreg_enheter] Products / services named on its website: Our Services; KSATmax; KSATlite - Smart, Secure and Scalable Ground Operations; KSAT Launch & LEOP; KSAT Hosted; KSAT Lunar; Satellite Operation; The KSAT Global Ground Network. Main industry (NACE 61.100): Kabelbasert, satellittbasert og trådløs telekommunikasjon. [brreg_enheter]

Registered purpose: "Utvikle og levere tjenester til eiere og operatører av polarbane-satellitter, samt eie og delta i andre selskap som driver lignende virksomhet, samt alt som står i forbindelse hermed." [brreg_enheter]

The company's website describes it as: "KSAT is a world leading provider of communication services for spacecraft and launch vehicles from our uniquely located global ground network, and provides advanced monitoring services with rapid delivery based on multiple satellite missions." [website]
